title: Regional chat STOMP CONNECT native headers
description: B1/F1. Identity is derived from verified access JWT sub/sid. auth_session_id is an optional equality assertion, never a standalone credential. JWTs without a canonical UUID sid are rejected.

auth_session_id.description: If supplied, must exactly equal the signed JWT sid. Removed from native headers after processing.

view_session_id.description: Independent tab reading context; not an auth session.
